computePodDisruptionBudget.description: Optional PodDisruptionBudget for a compute-plane Deployment (issue #1574). minAvailable, when set, replaces maxUnavailable. A budget allowing zero voluntary disruptions at the configured replica count needs allowBlockingDrain: true; the template refuses it otherwise.

config.description: Installed configuration schema stamp written by the CLI on every install and upgrade (issue #2299).

schemaVersion.description: Configuration schema version persisted with the Helm release.

migratedFrom.description: Schema or chart version the previous document was migrated from. Empty on a fresh current-schema install.

approvalChatAttesterSecret.description: Independent Slack approval attestation credential. Explicit values must contain a non-whitespace character; a missing legacy value is generated by the managed Secret helper during upgrade (issue #2194).

githubReviewIngressEnabled.description: Opt-in gate for authenticated GitHub review-feedback ingress. The API validates the required App credentials and non-default webhook secret at boot.

githubReviewReconcilerIntervalSeconds.description: Positive cadence in seconds for reconciling accepted GitHub review feedback.

githubFactoryIngressEnabled.description: Opt-in gate for GitHub issue admission. Poll mode does not require a webhook secret. Webhook mode requires a non-default webhook secret. The API also validates the App credentials, label, mention login, and allowlist at boot.

githubFactoryIntake.description: Factory intake mode. poll is the default and reads GitHub on an interval. webhook keeps signed deliveries and the missed-label backstop.

githubFactoryPollIntervalSeconds.description: Seconds between factory poll passes when intake is poll. Must be a positive finite number. Default 45.

githubFactoryLabel.description: Issue label that requests initial factory admission. Empty while intake is off.

githubFactoryCardBaseUrl.description: Public https origin GitHub's image proxy fetches the live factory status card from. Empty omits the card image.

githubFactoryCiWaitSeconds.description: Seconds a published factory run waits on its pull request's CI, from the push. The execution deadline still caps it.

githubFactoryBases.description: Bases a factory ticket may start from and target, keyed by owner/name. A repository without an entry may only use its default branch.

githubFactoryPythonCi.description: Required Python CI per repository, keyed by owner/name. A repository without an entry is judged on its own checks.

githubFactoryMention.description: GitHub login an authorized human must mention to request another execution. Empty while intake is off.

maxConcurrency.description: Turns one worker runs at once (issue #760), rendered as CURIE_WORKER_MAX_CONCURRENCY. The worker refuses the same range at boot.

claimTimeoutSeconds.description: Seconds claim() waits for a cold sandbox create to bind. Must be greater than 0 and at most 31536000 (one year). 0 or a negative value installs green and then fails on every turn, so helm refuses it here rather than letting it reach worker env (issue #1388).

routeTtlSeconds.description: Seconds a thread pins its sandbox after its last message. Must be greater than 0 and at most 31536000 (one year). Integer rather than number on purpose: a YAML float renders through the template's `| quote` as scientific notation for larger values (the class documented at ci/github-app-credential-assertions.sh:11), which the worker then cannot parse.

suspendedRouteTtlSeconds.description: Seconds a route suspended awaiting an approval pins its sandbox. Must be greater than 0 and at most 31536000 (one year). Integer rather than number for the same reason as routeTtlSeconds: a YAML float renders through `| quote` as scientific notation for larger values (ci/github-app-credential-assertions.sh:11).

minAgeSeconds.description: Seconds a settled stream entry is kept before the worker trims it (ADR 0184). At least 3600, above the three-hour delivery budget ceiling, and at most 31536000 (one year). Integer for the same reason as routeTtlSeconds.

deliveryBudgetSeconds.description: Overall wall-clock deadline for one delivery (ADR-0131). The shipped default is 10800, equal to the factory maximum execution deadline. Below 60s a budget cannot cover claim + one runner request + settle; at most 10800s (three hours, #3071). The rendered termination grace follows it: max(terminationGracePeriodSeconds, this + deliveryShutdownReserveSeconds). runnerTotalTimeoutSeconds must be no greater than deliveryBudgetSeconds.

runnerTotalTimeoutSeconds.description: Positive per-request ceiling for runner work. The shipped default is 10800, equal to the factory maximum execution deadline, and at most 10800 seconds. Must be no greater than worker.deliveryBudgetSeconds; the worker template enforces this cross-field relationship at render time.

deliveryLeaseTtlSeconds.description: How long the renewable ownership lease lives before it is considered expired and transferable (ADR-0131). Must be at least 3x deliveryLeaseHeartbeatSeconds; the worker's own validator enforces the relationship, not this schema.

deliveryLeaseHeartbeatSeconds.description: How often the delivery lease owner renews its lease and resets its PEL idle (ADR-0131). Too large relative to deliveryLeaseTtlSeconds drops a healthy owner's lease on a single missed heartbeat; the worker's own validator enforces that relationship.

workItemMaxTurns.description: Turn budget for a work-item (factory) delivery (#3071), rendered as CURIE_WORK_ITEM_MAX_TURNS and written into that delivery's sandbox as CURIE_MAX_TURNS. Other deliveries keep the runner default. A run that exhausts it fails as max-turns.

turnReceipt.description: What the receipt beneath a turn's reply shows (ADR-0180), rendered as CURIE_TURN_RECEIPT: all (every action, the default), failures (only actions that reported failure) or off (none). The worker refuses any other value at startup, so the schema admits only these three.

deliveryShutdownReserveSeconds.description: Budget reserved for fenced terminal settlement after runner work completes (ADR-0131). The rendered termination grace is at least deliveryBudgetSeconds plus this value, so a draining worker can settle before SIGKILL.

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Floor for the voluntary Pod termination grace before SIGKILL. The chart renders max(this, deliveryBudgetSeconds + deliveryShutdownReserveSeconds) (ADR-0131, #1971, #3071), so a worker draining a maximum-budget turn is never killed at the moment it would settle; below 60s not even a fast drain reliably completes.

upgradeDrain.description: Pre-upgrade drain gate (issue #2010): quiesce new claims and drain already-accepted deliveries to their terminal outcome before the roll, or refuse the upgrade while unsafe in-flight work exists.

timeoutSeconds.description: Floor for how long the gate waits for in-flight deliveries before refusing the upgrade. The effective wait is raised to at least deliveryBudgetSeconds + deliveryShutdownReserveSeconds so the gate never gives up on a delivery still inside the budget ADR-0131 promised it.

quiesceTtlSeconds.description: Roll hold: lifetime of the fleet-wide quiesce flag after a clean drain, capped at the effective drain wait (issue #3127). While the gate waits, the flag is a short lease renewed every poll, so a killed gate releases the fleet within one lease. Finite by construction, so an upgrade killed between the two hooks cannot leave the fleet permanently unable to claim.

resources.description: Shared resources for the drain, attest and release hook Jobs. Worker dependency imports peaked at approximately 148Mi in subprocess measurements, so the default memory request and limit are both 384Mi. When overriding, size both memory request and limit to at least twice the deployed worker image's measured peak.

e2eConnector.description: Factory side of the end to end connector (ADR 0176 decisions 1 to 3, issue #3244).

actionExecutor.description: The connector action executor switch (ACTION-EXECUTOR-1), rendered into both the API and the worker. A boolean, so a quoted "false" cannot turn it on.

remediation.description: The automated remediation switch (AUTOMATED-REMEDIATION-1), rendered into both the API and the worker. Requires actionExecutor.enabled. A boolean, so a quoted "true" cannot turn it on.

e2eConnectorIdentity.description: End to end connector identity on a test cluster (ADR 0176 decision 4, issue #3243).
